heading: A Connection Across Town
intro: You have a little time before your next train. Explore the plaza, speak with the people nearby, and decide where to head next.

objectives.instruction: Take in the plaza and its exits
Speak with Maya about the neighborhood, and ask her what the flyer is about
Read the flyer on the bench along the library walk to the north
The library lobby keeps a shelf of things people have left behind; take one
Bring it to Devon at the corner café east of the plaza
